dedupe_keys.name: peak wind effects on rooftop photovoltaic arrays

description: Peak Wind Effects on Rooftop Photovoltaic Arrays is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Arindam Gan Chowdhury, Florida International University (fiu.edu). Understanding the peak wind effects on rooftop PV arrays will help in designing arrays that are more resistant to extreme conditions. This research will aid in making these renewable electrical grids much more reliable, and in turn, will positively impact the economy and public safety. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-wby0-3s64. Keywords: PV array, Wall of Wind, field measurements, pressure coefficients, ASCE 7-16. Published 2021-08-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
